title: Parse server logs
hints: Split the job in two: first cut the line into time / level / message, then check that the level is one of the three allowed values.
A regex with groups does the cutting: `/^(\S+) \[(\w+)\] (.+)$/`. For the level check, `level === "INFO" || level === "WARN" || level === "ERROR"` narrows a `string` down to `LogLevel`.
For `parseLog`: `text.split("\n").map(parseLogLine)` and then filter out the nulls with `.filter((e): e is LogEntry => e !== null)`.
